description: Legacy owner-wallet return workflow, still under certification; it may stop at an intermediate owner wallet. Retain the original ID, key and hashes for an interrupted legacy operation; never use a new key to bypass an uncertain result.

resume_reconciliation.description: Resume only this exact previously reconciled workflow.
